author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
- GO:0007164 establishment of tissue polarity

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32697

Impacted groups (experimental annotations):
TAIR	1
UniProt	1
~FlyBase	1~ DONE
~RGD	1~ DONE
~ZFIN	1~ DONE

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)
* None. There are no InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keyword, UniRule or EC mappings to this term.

### Annotations needing action (5 annotations)

| Gene | Ev | Ref | Group | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pk (fly, FB:FBgn0003090) | IMP | PMID:12015986 | UniProt | **Remove.** Already annotated from the same paper to GO:0001736 establishment of planar polarity. Prickle mediates "feedback amplification to generate asymmetric planar cell polarity signaling"; consider GO:7770140 core planar cell polarity. |
| ft (fly, FB:FBgn0001075) | IMP | PMID:16735478 | FlyBase | **Replace with GO:0001736 establishment of planar polarity**, or GO:7770141 Fat/Dachsous planar cell polarity. The abstract refers to "the tissue polarity defects of fat mutants" (abstract only). |
| ccdc57 (zebrafish, ZDB-GENE-090603-1) | IMP | PMID:36862758 | ZFIN | **Replace with GO:0001736 establishment of planar polarity.** "Ccdc57 localizes to ciliary basal bodies and controls the planar polarity of ependymal cells through regulating the organization of microtubule networks and proper positioning of basal bodies." Ccdc57 acts downstream of the core PCP proteins. |
| Hnf4a (rat, RGD:2810) | IDA | PMID:12749857 | RGD | **Replace with GO:0045198 establishment of epithelial cell apical/basal polarity and/or GO:0120192 tight junction assembly.** This is apical/basal polarity, not tissue (planar) polarity: "HNF-4alpha triggers de novo formation of functional tight junctions and establishment of epithelial cell polarity" (abstract only). |
| PIP5K4 (Arabidopsis, AT3G56960) | IMP | PMID:19033528 | TAIR | **Replace with GO:0030011 maintenance of cell polarity**, or remove (the same paper already gives GO:0009860 pollen tube growth). This is polarity within single pollen tube cells, not tissue polarity: "PIP5K4 plays a crucial role in regulating the polarity of pollen tubes." |

Full text was read for PMID:36862758 and PMID:19033528; only the abstracts were available for the other three.

Thanks.
